chain.title: Reach Out and Grab
chain.desc: An RF Coil, iron, lead and redstone. The Flux Magnet vacuums dropped items to you while it holds charge - mining and mob farming stop meaning walking in circles.

chain.title: The Powered Saw
chain.desc: A Saw Blade (iron and copper), an RF Coil, tin and gold gears. Chews through wood on Redstone Flux instead of durability - recharge it in a Flux Capacitor or energy cell and it never breaks.

chain.title: Bucket, Evolved
chain.desc: A Redstone Servo, Cured Rubber, copper, glass and a bucket. Holds a deep tank of fluid, places and picks up sources, and auto-refills fluid-using gear you carry.

chain.title: Potions on Tap
chain.desc: Silver gears, copper, rubber and a glass bottle. Fill it with many doses of one potion and drink from it repeatedly - brewing stops being a per-bottle chore.

chain.title: The Alchemical Quiver
chain.desc: The Potion Infuser's stringed sibling. Stores arrows and a potion together, and every arrow you draw comes out tipped - lingering effects without crafting tipped arrows one by one.

collections.note: The complete Innovation toolbelt - every item in the module. Flux Capacitor and Flux Drill are anchored in thermal.json's main chain; the capacitor is the pocket charger that keeps the rest of these running.

notes: Innovation is a genuinely tiny module: exactly 7 items (fluid_reservoir, flux_capacitor, flux_drill, flux_magnet, flux_saw, potion_infuser, potion_quiver), verified as the complete set of recipes in data/thermal/recipes/ of this jar; item.thermal.flux_pump exists as a lang key in thermal_core but has no recipe or model here, so it is unimplemented and excluded. flux_capacitor and flux_drill are deliberately NOT chain steps because thermal.json's spine already quests both; the chain covers the remaining five in dependency order (magnet needs only an RF Coil plus base metals; saw needs the Saw Blade tool component from thermal_core; reservoir needs Redstone Servo and Cured Rubber; the potion pair needs silver gears). All ingredient claims read from the recipe JSONs.
